scope: First frozen-code extraction of a previously untested publisher's original11page release. All10native and2source-tagged profiles run uniformly on complete original bytes with default resource limits. Three complete issuer statements span original pages4/5,5/6,6/7. One geometry-only maxIoU>=.5 association per region, stable first tie; concatenate emitted nonblank rows in fixed original-page order, with no boundary/header deduplication, text repair or fragment omission. Partial associations and complete original reference rows remain in all scores. Reused source inspection makes this a frozen-code transfer/development diagnostic, not independently human-reviewed heldout acceptance or a general accuracy estimate.
